sources_note: 來源與日期逐篇列明。公司公告按原文歸因，開放範圍以可核對的資料為準。
sources_note_en: Each story lists its source and date. Company announcements are attributed and availability follows the documented scope.
thesis: AI由分析走向廣告操作，審批與衡量要跟上
thesis_en: As AI moves from analysis to ad operations, approval and measurement need to follow
thesis_note: 由批次改預算到素材審閱，每項更新都要對應實際工序和決策，並保留推出階段及公司歸因。
thesis_note_en: From bulk budget changes to creative review, each update maps to a specific workflow and decision, with rollout stages and company attribution preserved.

items.title: Xnurta MCP加入廣告寫入，預算與出價變動須先確認
items.summary: Xnurta宣布擴展MCP連接，讓AI助理以自然語言建立、調整及管理Amazon贊助廣告。
highlights: 支援Sponsored Products、Sponsored Brands及Sponsored Display。
預算、出價和封存變動須先顯示預覽，並由人員確認後生效。
items.why: 從分析走到帳戶寫入，會直接改變零售媒體操作風險；團隊可決定哪些批次修改適合由助理提出再審批。
items.next_step: 以一組促銷後需要還原的預算測試預覽，核對活動清單、原金額和擬改金額，再確認支援的動作。
items.detail: MCP是一種讓AI助理連接外部工具的協定。Xnurta表示，更新後可批次調整預算、出價、關鍵字和定向，也可按既有範本建立活動。Amazon DSP的唯讀接入仍屬後續計劃。團隊可以先檢查批次預覽是否完整列出受影響活動，並把寫入權限限制在可回查和批准的操作範圍內。
items.title_en: Xnurta MCP adds ad write actions with confirmation for bids and budgets
items.summary_en: Xnurta expanded its MCP connection so AI assistants can create, adjust and manage Amazon sponsored ads through natural-language instructions.
highlights_en: It supports Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display.
Budget, bid and archive changes require a preview and human confirmation before taking effect.
items.why_en: Moving from analysis to account writes changes retail media operations. Teams can choose which bulk changes an assistant may propose for review.
items.next_step_en: Test a post-promotion budget reset preview and reconcile campaign names, old amounts and proposed amounts before confirmation.
items.detail_en: MCP is a protocol connecting AI assistants to external tools. Xnurta lists bulk budget, bid, keyword and targeting adjustments and template-based creation. Read-only Amazon DSP access remains planned. Teams can check that previews show all affected campaigns and limit writes to operations they can review and approve.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Clinch把Higgsfield及字節模型接入廣告製作流程
items.summary: Clinch宣布在Flight Control加入Higgsfield、Seedream及Seedance，把圖像與影片生成接入廣告製作和投放流程。
highlights: 團隊可比較不同模型，並按組織設定模型存取及素材審批。
生成素材可進入可重用的動態廣告框架，再延伸至投放和衡量。
items.why: 這次整合把選模型和組裝廣告放進同一流程，創意營運團隊可評估哪些規格變體適合在平台內完成。
items.next_step: 選一組多尺寸商品廣告，分別用新增模型製作變體，核對素材框架能否保留必要文字及商品細節。
items.detail: Clinch表示，Seedream支援圖像生成，Seedance提供影片生成，Higgsfield則加入圖像與影片製作能力。Flight Control會把品牌指引、受眾、活動目標和素材規格用於內容製作。團隊可用同一組廣告規格比較模型，再追查從生成檔案到廣告框架的修改記錄，以決定哪些步驟仍需人工處理。
items.title_en: Clinch brings Higgsfield and ByteDance models into ad production
items.summary_en: Clinch added Higgsfield, Seedream and Seedance integrations to Flight Control, connecting image and video generation with ad production and activation.
highlights_en: Teams can compare models and configure model access and creative approvals.
Generated assets can flow into reusable dynamic creative frameworks and on to activation and measurement.
items.why_en: With model choice and ad assembly in one workflow, creative operations teams can assess which format variants to produce there.
items.next_step_en: Test one multi-size product ad set with the new models and check whether its framework preserves required text and product details.
items.detail_en: Clinch says Seedream supplies image generation, Seedance adds video, and Higgsfield supports both. Flight Control uses brand guidance, audience definitions, campaign goals and creative specifications. Compare models against one specification set and trace revisions into the ad framework to decide which steps still need manual work.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: smartclip在smartx加入AI素材審核建議，初期保留人員把關
items.summary: smartclip推出Creative Approval Agent，協助電視台及優質媒體的素材審核團隊按廣告語境評估內容。
highlights: 系統可建議批准、附投放限制批准，或拒絕素材。
初期推出採人員參與模式，支援青少年保護、競品限制及市場規則等審閱。
items.why: 廣告審核開始由辨認物件延伸至判斷情境，媒體團隊可先決定哪些限制需要人工確認才能套用。
items.next_step: 用酒類產品與非酒類產品的相似畫面檢查建議，逐項比較系統如何解釋情境和投放限制。
items.detail: smartclip以廣告中的瓶子為例，說明同一外觀可能是葡萄酒，也可能是醋；郵輪廣告中出現香檳，亦涉及產品和場景的區別。這類判斷會影響素材是否可在特定版位投放。媒體團隊可以把既有規則轉成一組有明確答案的案例，檢查建議理由是否足夠供審核人員覆查。
items.title_en: smartclip adds AI creative review recommendations with human oversight
items.summary_en: smartclip launched Creative Approval Agent to help broadcaster and premium publisher review teams assess ads in context.
highlights_en: It can recommend approval, approval with delivery restrictions or rejection.
Initial rollout keeps people involved and supports youth protection, competitor restrictions and market rules.
items.why_en: As review moves from object detection to context, media teams can decide which restrictions need a person's confirmation.
items.next_step_en: Compare similar alcohol and non-alcohol imagery and examine the reasoning behind proposed delivery restrictions.
items.detail_en: smartclip uses a wine bottle versus vinegar, and champagne in a cruise ad, to illustrate context. Those distinctions can affect placement eligibility. Teams can turn existing policies into cases with known decisions and check whether the agent's reasoning lets reviewers verify a recommendation.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 快手第三季擴展UAX多代理協作，素材生成加入興趣訊號
items.summary: 快手在第三季業績公告中披露，UAX全自動投放已由單點策略擴成多代理協作。
highlights: 公司表示，新框架可診斷帳戶投放問題並協調多項投放能力。
AIGC素材工具加入使用者興趣訊號，按既有素材未覆蓋的需求生成補充內容。
items.why: 帳戶診斷和素材補充開始協作，電商投放團隊可檢查應先處理受眾興趣缺口，還是調整出價及活動設定。
items.next_step: 選一個素材覆蓋不足的品類，比較UAX診斷與補充素材建議，分開記錄素材及競價變更。
items.detail: 快手亦披露另一項淨成交ROI產品的更新，包括活動中途切換及訂單取消、退貨模型調整。該產品在電商行銷投放中的滲透率由第二季28.0%升至第三季34.7%。這是公司披露的產品使用比例，團隊可把採用率與自己帳戶的實際銷售、退款及投放變動分開核對。
items.title_en: Kuaishou reports Q3 UAX multi-agent changes and interest-led creative
items.summary_en: Kuaishou's third-quarter release says UAX automated ads evolved from a single-point strategy into a multi-agent framework.
highlights_en: The company says it diagnoses account delivery issues and coordinates multiple ad capabilities.
Its generative creative tool uses interest signals to fill gaps in the existing asset library.
items.why_en: Commerce teams can assess whether an account first needs better interest coverage or changes to bids and campaign settings.
items.next_step_en: Compare UAX diagnostics and suggested creative for one under-covered category and log creative and bidding changes separately.
items.detail_en: A separate Net Transaction ROI product added mid-campaign switching and cancellation and return-model changes. Its share of e-commerce marketing spend rose from 28.0% in Q2 to 34.7% in Q3, according to Kuaishou. That is a usage measure. Teams can assess their own sales, refunds and delivery changes separately.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: PubMatic統籌Sugree國際採購，連接日本地面電視廣告
items.summary: Nippon TV委任PubMatic為Sugree的主要國際合作夥伴，集中處理海外買方對日本地面電視廣告的採購。
highlights: 海外廣告主可經PubMatic區域團隊處理帳戶接入、活動管理、報表及結帳。
Sugree在2025年推出，支援按曝光交易的程式化電視廣告。
items.why: 跨市場媒體團隊可把日本地面電視納入按曝光採購的規劃，並比較單一窗口是否能解決當地操作及結算需求。
items.next_step: 索取Sugree可買節目時段、曝光計價及報表欄位，與既有日本電視採購流程逐項比較。
items.detail: PubMatic表示，其北美、歐洲、中東非洲及亞太團隊會為國際買方提供語言和時區支援。這次公布的是國際合作角色擴展，Sugree平台已在較早階段推出。媒體團隊可先核對地面電視版位和既有串流影片採購在曝光定義、排期及報表上的差異，再判斷是否應使用同一預算比較。
items.title_en: PubMatic becomes Sugree's main international buying partner
items.summary_en: Nippon TV named PubMatic its primary international partner for Sugree, centralizing overseas access to Japanese terrestrial TV inventory.
highlights_en: Regional teams will handle onboarding, campaign management, reporting and billing.
Sugree launched in 2025 and supports impression-based programmatic TV transactions.
items.why_en: Cross-market media teams can assess Japanese broadcast TV within impression-based planning and compare the single contact with local operating needs.
items.next_step_en: Request bookable programming, impression pricing and reporting fields and compare them with current Japanese TV buying.
items.detail_en: PubMatic says teams in North America, EMEA and APAC provide language and time-zone support. The announcement expands its international role for an existing platform. Buyers can compare broadcast inventory with streaming video on impression definitions, scheduling and reporting before putting both into the same budget comparison.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Circana擬把購買數據接入The Trade Desk受眾及衡量
items.summary: Circana與The Trade Desk公布擴展合作，計劃讓購買數據連接受眾啟動、廣告優化及成效衡量。
highlights: Intelligence Stream及Sales Lift將接入Audience Unlimited和Open Measurement。
雙方希望讓活動結果回饋後續的受眾和優化決策，整合仍屬公布中的計劃。
items.why: 以實際購買作共同訊號，會影響品牌如何挑選受眾和評估媒體；採購前可先確認能涵蓋哪些商品及通路。
items.next_step: 向合作方索取適用市場、商品覆蓋和對照組方法，再判斷是否可用於下一次銷售提升測試。
items.detail: Circana把這次合作描述為連接原本分開的受眾、優化及衡量工序。其購買資料主要服務消費品與零售領域，Open Measurement則是The Trade Desk計劃推出的框架。團隊可先列出活動中的商品及販售通路，確認資料能否覆蓋，再核對銷售提升的計算方法和比較基準，決定測試是否可行。
items.title_en: Circana plans purchase-data links to Trade Desk audiences and measurement
items.summary_en: Circana and The Trade Desk expanded their partnership with planned links between purchase data, audience activation, optimization and measurement.
highlights_en: Intelligence Stream and Sales Lift will connect to Audience Unlimited and Open Measurement.
The planned feedback loop uses campaign outcomes to inform later audience and optimization decisions.
items.why_en: A shared purchase signal affects audience selection and media evaluation. Buyers can first establish product and channel coverage.
items.next_step_en: Request market coverage, product coverage and control-group methods before planning a sales-lift test.
items.detail_en: Circana describes the partnership as connecting previously separate audience, optimization and measurement work. Its purchase intelligence serves consumer goods and retail, while Open Measurement is a planned Trade Desk framework. Match campaign products and sales channels to coverage, then assess the sales-lift method and comparison baseline.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: MSQ在亞洲推出Signal，以AI答案訊號連接內容製作
items.summary: MSQ在新加坡介紹MSQ Signal，把品牌、社群、搜尋及AI答案訊號帶進內容規劃與製作。
highlights: 服務以TikTok及電商為起點，可按品牌需要加入付費媒體、創作者及零售媒體。
據現場報道，MSQ示範重複執行購物提示詞，觀察品牌在AI答案的推薦佔比。
items.why: AI答案成為內容迭代的觀察訊號，區域團隊可先確定哪些購物問題值得納入固定追蹤，再決定要改哪些內容。
items.next_step: 挑選同一市場、語言及品類的購物問題，保留每次答案與內容變更日期，檢查是否出現可重複觀察的差異。
items.detail: Branding in Asia引述MSQ管理層，介紹從發現訊號、發展創意到推出內容及觀察反應的工作循環。MSQ把這套流程建於亞洲社群和電商環境，並在活動示範AI推薦佔比的追蹤。團隊可以先固定一批問題及觀察條件，再把答案變化與內容更新並列，作為後續研究的起點。
items.title_en: MSQ launches Signal in Asia to connect AI answer signals with content
items.summary_en: MSQ introduced MSQ Signal in Singapore to bring brand, social, search and AI answer signals into content planning and production.
highlights_en: It starts with TikTok and commerce and can add paid media, creators and retail media.
Event reporting describes repeated shopper prompts used to track a brand's share of recommendations in AI answers.
items.why_en: Regional teams can choose which shopping questions merit consistent tracking before deciding what content to change.
items.next_step_en: Fix a market, language and product category for a prompt set and retain answers alongside content-change dates.
items.detail_en: Branding in Asia quotes MSQ executives on a cycle from signal discovery to creative development, content release and observation. The Asia-built workflow included a demonstration of AI recommendation tracking. Teams can hold questions and observation conditions steady and compare answer changes with content updates as a starting point for further research.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: IAB Australia發布搜尋技能框架，把AI與整體能見度納入培訓
items.summary: IAB Australia發布Future Search Skills，提出搜尋行銷人員在自動化環境下需要建立的技能。
highlights: 框架涵蓋AI搜尋、整體搜尋能見度，以及搜尋專長配合另一領域的複合技能。
研究提供四階段學習框架、六類複合角色及初級人才技能清單。
items.why: 當出價、建案和報表更自動化，團隊可重新分配培訓時間，讓初級同事仍能學會理解及覆查系統的決定。
items.next_step: 以一個搜尋活動列出AI已接手的工序，再用技能清單安排對應的人工分析與覆查練習。
items.detail: 官方頁面說明，研究結合品牌、代理商、媒體、平台及零售媒體工作小組的經驗，以及專門招聘搜尋和成效人才的招聘顧問調查。它也討論當點擊已不足以解釋表現時，如何衡量整體搜尋。主管可按現有活動的實際分工，決定哪些技能需要透過個案練習保留。研究亦把初級人才如何累積實務經驗列為專題。
items.title_en: IAB Australia sets out AI and whole-of-search skills for training
items.summary_en: IAB Australia published Future Search Skills to guide search marketers as routine work becomes automated.
highlights_en: The framework covers AI-driven search, whole-of-search visibility and combining search depth with another specialty.
It includes a four-stage learning framework, six hybrid personas and a junior skills checklist.
items.why_en: As bidding, setup and reporting automate, teams can preserve junior staff's ability to understand and review system decisions.
items.next_step_en: Map automated tasks in one search campaign to the checklist and design corresponding analysis and review exercises.
items.detail_en: The official page combines working-group expertise from brands, agencies, publishers, platforms and retail media with a specialist recruiter survey. It also addresses measurement when clicks alone do not explain performance. Managers can use the actual division of campaign work to choose skills that still need case-based practice.

items.title: 可口可樂Enjoy Joy節日新片採實拍，重看AI製作選擇
items.summary: 據Marketing Dive報道，可口可樂推出Enjoy Joy節日影片，這次採用傳統實拍方式呈現家庭及朋友相聚。
highlights: 影片由WPP Open X及Ogilvy打造，Paul Dektor執導，Mayan Productions製作。
30秒、15秒及6秒版本會用於電視、數位、串流及社群渠道。
items.why: 當同一品牌在節日檔期選用不同製作方式，創意團隊可按人物表演、場景及版本需求決定哪些段落適合實拍或AI生成。
items.next_step: 在下一個節日brief中逐鏡列出需要真人表演的情節與需變體的畫面，再據此分配製作方法。
items.detail: 作為歷史背景，Marketing Dive在2025年3月10日訪問可口可樂AI主管，回顧2024年以生成式AI重製節日廣告。本次2026年Enjoy Joy報道則介紹導演及實拍製作。兩者的共同問題是節日品牌敘事如何選擇製作技術；新片取向可供團隊討論人物表演與版本需求，並按每個項目的創意要求取捨。
items.title_en: Coca-Cola's Enjoy Joy films use live action, revisiting production choices
items.summary_en: Marketing Dive reports that Coca-Cola's Enjoy Joy holiday films use conventional live-action production for scenes of family and friends.
highlights_en: WPP Open X and Ogilvy created the work, directed by Paul Dektor and produced by Mayan Productions.
The 30-, 15- and six-second versions span TV, digital, streaming and social.
items.why_en: Different production choices within one brand's holiday work let creative teams assess acting, scene and version needs when choosing live action or AI.
items.next_step_en: In the next holiday brief, identify scenes needing live performance and shots needing variations before assigning production methods.
items.detail_en: For dated context, a March 10, 2025 Marketing Dive interview reviewed Coca-Cola's 2024 AI remake of holiday advertising. The 2026 Enjoy Joy report describes a director-led live-action production. Both concern technology choices for seasonal brand storytelling. Teams can assess performance and variation needs against each project's creative requirements.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: 更進新聞：Genie 4向合資格Ultra訂戶推出互動世界生成
items.summary: Google開始向合資格AI Ultra訂戶推出Genie 4，讓使用者在瀏覽器探索並修改生成的互動世界。
highlights: 使用者可在場景中以文字改變天氣、加入角色，音訊亦會隨場景變動。
AI Pro用戶可登記候補；Google列出延遲、物理互動及場景持續性等研究限制。
items.why: 互動概念設計團隊可評估即時改場景能否支援提案探索，再決定是否投入製作可交付的體驗。
items.next_step: 先列一段品牌體驗需要保留的物件和視角，取得資格後測試持續性，並記錄哪些改動會破壞場景。
items.detail: Google同時加入Project Genie創作助理與社群作品庫，讓使用者以對話建立世界或探索其他人的作品。公司表示，生成的影片和音訊均帶有SynthID浮水印，Genie 3及Genie 4仍屬前沿研究。品牌團隊可以把探索結果整理為概念參考，並在確定交付方式前逐項核對穩定性及使用條款。
items.title_en: Update: Genie 4 reaches eligible Ultra users for interactive world generation
items.summary_en: Google began rolling out Genie 4 to eligible AI Ultra subscribers for exploring and editing generated worlds in a browser.
highlights_en: Users can change weather or add characters by prompting mid-session, with audio adapting to the scene.
AI Pro users can join a waitlist. Google lists latency, physical interaction and scene-persistence limits.
items.why_en: Interactive concept teams can assess live scene editing for proposal exploration before committing to a deliverable experience.
items.next_step_en: Define the objects and viewpoints a brand experience must preserve, then test persistence once eligible and record disruptive changes.
items.detail_en: Google also added a Project Genie creation agent and a community gallery. Generated audio and video carry SynthID watermarks, and Genie 3 and 4 remain research models. Teams can use explorations as concept references and check stability and terms before choosing a delivery format.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.followup: 10月28日本刊報道Genie 4的可信測試者預覽。這次新增合資格Ultra訂戶入口、創作助理及作品庫。
items.followup_en: Our October 28 issue covered the trusted-tester preview. This update adds eligible Ultra access, a creation agent and a gallery.
